content: प्रशमन {%a.%} (-नी|{%f.%}) .²1 Calming, tranquillizing, pacifying, removing <ab>&c.</ab> .²2 Curing, healing. .{@-नम्@} .²1 Calming, tranquillizing, pacifying. .²2 Allaying, assuaging, soothing, mitigating; आपन्नार्तिप्रशमनफलाः संपदो ह्युत्तमानाम् <ls>Me. 55</ls>. .²3 Curing, healing; as in व्याधिप्रशमनम्. .²4 Quenching, extinguishing, suppressing, quelling; <ls>Mb. 5. 165. 9</ls>. .²5 Cessation, abatement. .²6 Bestowing fitly or on fit objects; लब्धप्रशमनं कृत्वा <ls>Mb. 12. 45. 10</ls> (<ab>com.</ab> लब्धस्य धनादेः यथोचितमंशतः पात्रे समर्पणेन शान्तिकम्) <ls>Ms. 7. 56</ls>; (सत्पात्रे प्रतिपादनम् <ls>Kull.</ls>; but others give it the next sense). .²7 Securing, guarding, keeping safe; लब्धप्रशमनस्वस्थमथैनं समुपास्थिता <ls>R. 4. 14</ls>. .²8 Killing, slaughter. .²9 Restoration of peace; लब्धप्रशमनम् <ls>Kau. A.</ls>
